answer.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification lifted adoption. Verifying memory_31 (signup simplification for SMB activation) and memory_91 (in-product activation messaging) will confirm the most recent evidence for which lever to pull. Activation_messaging is the highest-confidence play given the immediate activation decline and avoids the retention risk flagged in memory_73 (promotional pricing materially reduced 30-day retention). Referral incentives (memory_57) work for established customers but won't address QoQ activation decay. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to the SMB activation crisis. A standard experiment on activation messaging targets the root symptom—disengagement in the critical first week—without incurring the long-term retention penalty of price competition or the complexity of onboarding overhauls that may have unintended side effects.
